stem.en: Meena and Hari saw an animal in their garden. Hari called it an insect and Meena said it was an earthworm. Which feature confirms that it is an insect?

feedback.en: An earthworm's body also has two matching halves, so this cannot settle it.
Right. Insects have jointed legs, and an earthworm has no legs at all.
A cylindrical body fits the earthworm, not an insect.
Earthworms and insects are both clearly segmented, so this cannot settle it.

explanation.en: Insects are arthropods, with jointed legs and a hard outer skeleton. An earthworm has a soft, segmented body and no legs.

hints.en: Which feature does only one of the two animals have?
